description: WebDAVClient is a strongly-typed, async, C# client for WebDAV.
releaseNotes:
Version 2.8.0
* Developer experience: Ship XML documentation for both targets, safe configurable examples, early argument validation, qualified property statuses, explicit authentication factories, sanitized exception context, and complete configuration/ownership guidance.
* Configuration: Reject ineffective client TLS callbacks on injected transports and validate owned upload timeouts before transport allocation.
* Sample correctness: Report transfer-integrity failures with a nonzero exit while retaining run-owned cleanup.
* PROPPATCH correctness: Read statuses and descriptions only from direct propstat children, never nested property values.
* Performance: Filter listings in place, skip unused property-name XML, retain only selected single-item results, avoid PUT response buffering, and coordinate concurrent root discovery.
* Reliability: Cancellable asynchronous metadata parsing with configurable body deadlines; cancellation-aware discovery; consistent 409 exceptions; complete response ownership; member-level mutation recovery diagnostics.
* Bug fixes: Correct partial transfer ranges, connection reconfiguration, URL joining, sparse listings, targeted XML values, PROPFIND failure statuses, OPTIONS discovery, empty-namespace properties and hidden values.
* Security: Reject absolute WebDAV URLs outside the configured origin (scheme, hostname and effective port), preventing metadata-driven HTTPS downgrades and credential disclosure.
* Security: Scope PROPFIND resource identities and typed properties to their DAV namespace and structural position.
Historical context (already released in 2.7.0):
* Feature: WebDAV LOCK / UNLOCK support (RFC 4918 §9.10–9.11).
* Feature: WebDAV PROPPATCH support — set / remove custom properties (RFC 4918 §9.2).
* Bug fix: COPY / MOVE now send the Overwrite header (RFC 4918 §9.8.3 / §9.9.3); 204 No Content accepted as success.
* Bug fix: DELETE now sends Depth: infinity (RFC 4918 §9.6.1).
* Feature: per-call lock-token submission via the If header on PUT / DELETE / MOVE / COPY (RFC 4918 §10.4).
* Internal refactor: extracted Client.cs static helpers into focused, unit-testable helper classes under WebDAVClient.Helpers.
* Feature: PROPFIND request-body variants — <prop> and <propname/> in addition to <allprop/> (RFC 4918 §9.1).
* Feature: HTTP OPTIONS support — discover DAV compliance classes and allowed methods (RFC 4918 §9.1, RFC 9110 §9.3.7).
* Feature: Bearer token / OAuth 2.0 authentication via new Client constructor overloads (static token or async refreshable provider).
